limitations: This comparison does not establish visual improvement or AAA quality.
Mode2 preserves the complete-row linear mean before finite RGBA8 quantization; visible partial circumferences may have different local means.

Native Three r186 widens Uint16 index storage during first upload. The diagnostic reports that conversion separately and verifies all values exactly; no geometry buffers are changed by the diagnostic.
